title: Ducal Castle, Szczecin
scope: The reconstructed Pomeranian Dukes’ Castle exterior, including five wings, the Great and Mint courtyards, three principal towers and the ornate Renaissance south wing.
limitations: The native map fixes the compound plan and varied courtyard levels. The documented Bell Tower height controls the highest point. Other roof and tower heights, lower arcades on less visible sides and fine relief use reference proportions.
